text: Qualification plan codified in scripts/check-policy-processes.py and test-only PolicyProcessQualification/PolicyProcessWitness entry points. Disposable primary/witness/recovery containers use distinct UIDs, separate protected volumes, independent TLS identities and a separate PostgreSQL runtime login. Matrix targets eight primary boundaries, ENROLL/PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT/BARRIER record/head kills, exact/conflicting retries, pending restrictions/overtaking, actual primary database loss, running-service fencing/drain, gaps/reordering/tampering/capability/foreign trust and empty witness. Build in progress; no acceptance closure before observed outcomes and unchanged parent review.
